title: fix(metadata-protocol): two locales of one email template survive a restart — sys_metadata overlay rows keyed by bundle member (#22877, stage 1)
body:
Part of #22877
Clause-②: no

Stage 1 of 2 of ruling 6116165299 (letter A): the overlay store keys a bundled type's row by its member, so two locales of one `email_template` saved through the metadata door are two `sys_metadata` rows and both survive a restart. Stage 2 (the by-name member selector on the `/meta` doors, `Clause-②: yes`) is a separate PR; #22877 remains open for it.

The ruling, quoted:

> **A: the overlay store carries the bundled type's member as a key column; one table, one hydration path; each member addressable by name.**
>
> `sys_metadata` gains one nullable, type-neutral discriminator column. NULL means the canonical member, so every existing row and every type whose identity is `name` alone stays byte-identical. The value is taken from the body through `itemDiscriminator` (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`), the one place the identity is declared.

## What changed

- **Column** (`metadata-core` `sys-metadata.object.ts`): `bundle_member`, nullable text (`maxLength: 100`). NULL is the canonical member and every row of a name-only type. The declared `idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active` gains it.
- **Index** (`metadata-protocol` `migrations/overlay-index.ts`): the runtime key is `(type, name, organization_id, COALESCE(package_id, ''), COALESCE(bundle_member, ''))`, active and draft. The change rides the existing ADR-0120 D4 probe-then-replace order unchanged: it drops and rebuilds the real name on every first write, so the next boot replaces the four-part index. A key part only relaxes uniqueness, so no rows a store already holds can block the rebuild. The duplicate-listing query, the dialect fallback and the `os migrate duplicates` probes all read the same builders.
- **Backfill** (same module, `backfillOverlayBundleMembers`): through the engine, each `email_template` row with a NULL member whose body names a non-canonical locale gets that locale. It is run by boot hydration (`loadMetaFromDb`, after its own read succeeded) and by the first write. It is idempotent, never throws, and reports a failure at `error` with the consequence and the fix. A missing table counts as benign (`isMissingTableError`).
- **Repository** (`sys-metadata-repository.ts`): `put` takes the member from the body (`overlayMemberOfBody` → `itemDiscriminator`), never from the caller. The write head (inherited draft base and orphan adoption included), the row payload, `get`, `headAt`, `delete`, `promoteDraft` (and its drain), `restoreVersion` and `history` all address one member. An omitted `member` means the canonical one. For a name-only type, no `where` and no row payload ever carries the column.
- **Protocol** (`protocol.ts`): the save door addresses its stored head and its credential carry-forward by the body's member. The by-name reads that address rows directly (`findServedOverlayRow`, the publish door's draft read, the diff's active read and history rows) address the canonical member. A bare-name `getMetaItem` with no canonical stored row answers the code layer's canonical member, ahead of the registry's tier-first bare read.

## Pins (the ruling's, on real code)

`packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` + real protocol, `sys_metadata` registered from `SysMetadataObject`, a restart is a new engine and protocol over the same stores):

- two locales saved, then restart → each serves its own wording (the list the send path reads), and a re-save updates its own row;
- CONTROL: a single-locale save is unchanged (one row, member NULL; the other locale keeps the package wording);
- CONTROL: a package-shipped bundle is unchanged across a restart;
- a bare-name read answers the canonical member, also when only `zh-CN` is customized;
- a by-name reset removes the canonical member's overlay only;
- a row stored before the column existed is backfilled at boot from its body, and that locale's next save updates it.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/overlay-index.test.ts` (real SQLite, `node:sqlite`):

- the four-part index refuses a second locale (the defect at the index level);
- after the run the key is replaced, so two members coexist and a duplicate `(type, name, member)` is refused `UNIQUE constraint failed`;
- the backfill writes exactly the non-canonical bodies, and every other type's rows are byte-identical (all columns) before and after the backfill and the index rebuild.

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.bundle-member.test.ts`: the repository by member. It covers two rows, canonical defaults for read, delete, history and promote, a revert refused across members, and a CONTROL that no name-only payload or `where` carries the column.

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-two-locales-survive-boot.dogfood.test.ts`: the showcase on a real SQLite file through `PUT /meta`, real `sendTemplate` per locale, and a cold boot.

## Ablation

The member was dropped from the repository's write head: `const member = overlayMemberOfBody(ref.type, body);` became an expression that is `undefined` at runtime, carrying the marker `__ABLATION_22877_MEMBER_DROPPED`. The change was made through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed HEAD. The anchor count went 1 → 0, the marker count 0 → 1, and the blob `314afe10d8` → `a28c0832a6`. `metadata-protocol` was rebuilt (objectql resolves it through `dist/`), and `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the marker in `dist`.

- Mutated: the restart pin file goes `3 failed | 3 passed (6)`. The two-locale restart pin, the bare-name canonical pin and the by-name reset pin are red (the second save updates the first locale's row). Both CONTROLs (single locale, package bundle) and the backfill case stay green, as predicted.
- Restored: blob back to `314afe10d8`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `dist` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0, and the file goes `6 passed (6)`.

## Deviations and residuals, stated

- **Lineage counter stays per `(org, type, name)`**, not per member. `sys_metadata_history` declares `unique (organization_id, type, name, version)`, and a per-member counter would mint colliding versions under it, which would need a second index ceremony on a second table. With one counter per name, a version names exactly one snapshot. `history` and `restoreVersion` carry the member: history filters to one member, and a revert to another member's version answers `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND`.
- **History rows carry no member column.** A history row's member is read off its own body (and a tombstone's off the row it removed, by `previous_checksum`) through the same `overlayMemberOfBody`. No second table and no history migration.
- **Registry heal on a by-name reset** (`removeRuntimeShadow`) still sweeps the bundle's whole hydrated overlay group in the registry: the other member's REGISTRY entry drops until the next boot. Its row stays and is still served: the list and the send path read the store, as the reset pin shows. Member-aware registry heal belongs with stage 2's member-addressed DELETE.
- **Package-batch doors** (`publishPackageDrafts`, `discardPackageDrafts`, `revertCommit`, the cluster mutation fan-out) address the canonical member. Before this PR two members' drafts could not coexist, so nothing they did before changes. A non-canonical member's draft is published by a save naming its locale, or by stage 2's selector.
- **`os migrate duplicates` on a store this version has not booted yet** (a `sys_metadata` table without the member column): the overlay pre-flight first reads whether the column is present. When it is not, it lists duplicates with every row read as the empty member, so a live duplicate is still reported `blocked` and is never reported `unreadable`. Both statements live in `overlay-index.ts`. The choice between them is made in `runtime-index-preflight.ts`, which reports the statement that ran as the entry's `duplicateSql`. The report's keys are unchanged. On such a store, an `email_template` pair whose bodies name different locales can be reported and then not block once the serving boot's backfill has run. That errs in the strict direction. (Patch round 1, `f21b6f9d24`. This fixes the `packages/cli` duplicates integration red on `10f3b686f4`.)
- **A driver without partial indexes** (the ceremony's fallback arm, MySQL): the rebuild is refused there, as before, and is reported in the server log at the first metadata write. A store that booted before keeps its four-column declared UNIQUE under its name, because `syncDeclaredIndexes` skips by name. That index has never constrained an environment-wide overlay row: the metadata door stores no organization (ADR-0131 D6), and a UNIQUE key does not collide NULLs, in either the direct index or driver-sql's hash-shadow form. So two languages of one template coexist there too, and no save is refused. This was measured on SQLite (two members with `organization_id` NULL are both accepted; CONTROL: a non-NULL organization refuses the second member). It is not measured on a live MySQL. `os migrate plan` lists the declaration change as a destructive `recreate_index`, applied with `os migrate apply --allow-destructive`. A fresh store gets the five-column declaration. (Corrected after patch round 2: the earlier wording here said such a save is refused, which the dev's measurement 6119963033 falsified.)

## Acceptance notes

- **i18n bundles:** the regenerated `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` bundles carry the English source text for the new `bundle_member` keys, which still need translating. `check:i18n-coverage` stays green.
- **Caller census:** `packages/types/src/driver-error-classification.callers.test.ts` (a `domain:cli` file) gains one row for `overlay-index.ts`, the edit class the seat named. The sentinel pin sits in `metadata-protocol`.
- **Surface:** `metadata-protocol/src/migrations/runtime-index-preflight.ts` (and its test) is outside the claim's listed files but inside its package and directory. It is the module that reads `overlay-index.ts`'s statements. The edit is one function and a private table, and the seat accepted it as an in-lane deviation.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-overlay-index-drift.test.ts` keeps its own four-part fixture. It tests the drift detector's reading of a `COALESCE` key part and imports nothing changed here, so it stays a valid detector fixture.
- Two `objectql` harnesses (`environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`, `engine-security-catalog-package-door.test.ts`) hand-declare `sys_metadata`. They gain the `bundle_member` field the platform object declares, because the engine refuses an undeclared field in a `where`.
- `protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` records the new `lookupArtifactItem` site with its disposition. `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` records the new test file's pinned doubles (`--write`, additions only).
